_meta.schema: Each speaker entry must have: name (string), title (string), date (ISO YYYY-MM-DD), stance ('hawkish' | 'dovish' | 'neutral'), verified (ISO timestamp when last cross-checked), verifiedSource (URL of firm's published calendar entry).
_meta.purpose: Drives the Fed Speaker section of the home page breaking-news ticker. Loaded by backend/services/dashboardBuilder.js buildFedWatch(). Speakers whose date is in the past are auto-filtered out; if NONE remain, the ticker's Fed Speaker section is hidden entirely (no stale entries shown).
_meta.verificationCadence: 90-day rolling. See FED_SPEAKERS_VERIFICATION_TODO.md at repo root.
_meta.launchNote: Shipped empty per spec (Fix 4a) - user populates from federalreserve.gov when ready. An empty array is the correct fail-safe behavior: no Fed speaker section renders until at least one verified future-dated entry exists.
